description: What can be placed: furniture types for place_furniture (with default sizes in mm, category and style), including about 180 realistic models from the asset library ("ph:…": furniture, Lighting, Decor, Office, plants and trees; ceiling and wall lamps and pictures are hung automatically), the user's My library pieces ("custom:…"), and door and window types for place_opening. The built-in pieces (no prefix) are one modern set: prefer them, and library models of style "modern" or "any", unless the user wants a period look (classic, vintage, industrial, oriental). Filter by category in your own reasoning: the list is long.
name: list_catalogue
title: List catalogue
